summary: Iteration 4 E2E validation of the 5 new FleetIntel features. Backend: 29/29 pytest pass (added TestUnifiedAlerts, TestVehicleTimeline, TestIncidents CRUD+timeline, TestMaintenanceDriverSplit alongside iteration_3 suite). Frontend: full Playwright flow verified admin login, FleetIntel green branding, 9 configurable KPI tiles (uncheck -> 8, persists across reload via localStorage), reset-to-default, live-alerts-bar + anomaly-alert + parts-alert all rendered on dashboard, vehicle timeline opens, incident reported via UI and appears in the timeline, and regression navigation to Fleet/Templates/Maintenance/Parts/Drivers/Audit all load with no error nodes.
action_items: OPTIONAL: There is no standalone /incidents route/page in App.js — incident CRUD is only exposed via VehicleDetail (Report incident modal + timeline) and dashboard alert bucket. The spec item 'Incident Reports UI page' is satisfied functionally but not as a dedicated list page. If a top-level incidents index page is desired, add Incidents.jsx + route + sidebar link in /app/frontend/src/App.js and /app/frontend/src/components/Layout (sidebar).

OPTIONAL: KPI tile preferences persist via localStorage (client-only). If cross-device persistence is required, add a /api/users/me/prefs endpoint and read/write from there instead of localStorage in /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx (line ~82).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1787 lines — still exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers/ (auth, fleet, maintenance, incidents, analytics).

IncidentIn uses field 'occurred_at' (ISO string) while the review request phrasing says 'date' — the backend model uses occurred_at consistently across POST, list, timeline, and alerts, which is fine, but confirm this matches any external API contract documentation.
Dashboard.jsx duplicates alert rendering logic (live-alerts-bar + anomaly-alert + parts-alert) — could be consolidated into a single AlertsPanel component.
No PATCH/PUT endpoint for /api/incidents — only POST/GET/DELETE. If editing an incident post-creation is a business requirement, add an update route.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (dashboard config + alerts + vehicle timeline + incident report + module regression all verified)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 new features are working end-to-end. Backend suite is stable at 29/29. If main agent decides to add a standalone Incidents page, retest the /incidents index UI (list, severity badge rendering, delete). Otherwise, no further action required.
